tasks.title: install.sh --with-cross-browser flag
definition_of_done: `--with-cross-browser` flag parsed from `"$@"` at the top of `reference-impl/install.sh`
When flag is present on Linux, `npx playwright install-deps webkit firefox` is invoked instead of `npx playwright install-deps webkit`
When flag is absent, existing webkit-only behavior is preserved unchanged
When flag is absent, an informational note is printed explaining how to enable cross-browser support
Shell-mock regression test added under `reference-impl/tests/` or `reference-impl/scripts/` covering both flag-present and flag-absent code paths
acceptance_criteria: Running `install.sh --with-cross-browser` on Linux installs both webkit and firefox Playwright deps without error
Running `install.sh` without the flag installs webkit deps only and prints the informational note
Regression test passes without external network access (shell mocking / stubs) and is runnable in CI

tasks.title: .gitattributes merge=union for reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md merge=union` line is present in `.gitattributes` at the repo root (file created if absent; any existing lines preserved verbatim)

Regression test simulates two branches each appending a distinct `## [Unreleased]` bullet, performs a merge, then asserts both bullets are present in the result and no conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`) appear
acceptance_criteria: After merging two branches with concurrent distinct CHANGELOG bullets, both entries are present and no conflict markers exist in the file
Any pre-existing lines in `.gitattributes` are not removed or altered by the change
